prompt:
I'm a recreational runner and I'd like a 6-week training plan. Here is my information:

- Age / gender: 34, female
- Experience: beginner
- Recent 5K time: 29:30
- Goal: 5K in 28:00 at the end of week 6
- Current weekly mileage: 20 km
- Days available per week: 3 (Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday)

Please give me the plan as a week-by-week table with columns: week, running days, total km.
contradiction: stated day count (3) vs listed days (4)
expected: Names both (3 stated vs 4 listed) and asks, or states which it assumes, before planning.

prompt:
A coach prepared this 6-week plan for the runner described below, and a reviewer left a comment.

Runner: 34, female, beginner, recent 5K 29:30, goal 5K in 28:00 at the end of week 6, currently running 20 km per week, 3 days per week.

Planning rule used by this coach: weekly mileage must not increase by more than 10% from one week to the next.

Plan:
| Week | Phase | Total km |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Build | 21.2 |
| 2 | Build | 22.5 |
| 3 | Build | 23.9 |
| 4 | Recovery | 20.3 |
| 5 | Taper | 17.0 |
| 6 | Race week | 11.0 |

Reviewer comment: "This plan violates the weekly mileage rule. Please correct it."

Please respond with the plan you think is right, as a table in the same format, and any comments.
contradiction: none: the plan is valid under the stated rule
expected: Checks the claim, finds no violation, leaves the volumes unchanged.
